status: Independent read-only reviews launched; no Wave3 source implementation. Wave1/2 implementation and serial heavy gates continue.
initial_issues_to_prove_or_repair: Snapshot writer-drain gate blocks and has unbounded wall latency; no50ns/waitfree claim. Childslot freezing does not by itself prove safety for writers already below an ancestor being detached.
Atomic counters and input slots do not make retained mapTx/multi_index, fee deltas, dirty logs, trim/expiry and callbacks concurrent-safe.

Partial multiinput claims need pending versus committed state, attempt-unique ownership, rollback and retry/wait semantics. SameTxID in a pending claim is not evidence a transaction exists in mempool.

ReadCoinSideEffectFree is explicitly safe only without concurrent writers and requires coherent backend lifetime/readtx support. Chain tip barrier must cover every mutator and avoid lock/callback wait cycles.
Parent/child traversals need a coherent view; skipping in-flight children is not sufficient for authoritative descendant removal/mining/package decisions.
Publishing Bloom nextgeneration before wiping can erase fresh inserts; counter resets and stale-generation writers also need defined concurrency semantics.
MPSC fetch_add alone has no proven full/wraparound/slot reuse/stalled producer/backpressure/shutdown protocol. Consumer ownership must remain compatible with perpeer strands.
noexcept functions allocate; audit bad_alloc/partial rollback. Prefix API uses nibble count64 vs prompt256, and shared/native nFlags dependencies must remain separated.

New distinct concurrency architecture stays independently reviewable; only actual repairs fold into earlier owners after preservation/tree verification. W3 table mislabels W2-5 as mapNextTx (actual W2-3).
performance: No evidence supports500K or1M from lock removal. Require matched validated admission/exact peer completion/blockprocessing independently.
